note: Roughly 100 seconds. Hook first: the impossible thing before any setup. Every beat has footage the recorder produces, so the video is complete without filming anything. 05b is an optional swap if you shoot the ChatGPT conversation. Voice chosen by measurement: widest intonation spread of the four multilingual voices (4.45 semitones vs 3.39 for Ava, 2.55 for Brian), and the register OpenAI-facing material needs -- Microsoft tags it Warm, Confident, Authentic, Honest.

beats.footage: B-roll: the raw file scrolling, then the drop landing on 1,000,000 rows.
beats.text: A million people's salaries. Ninety-nine megabytes — twenty-six million tokens. No A-I can read a file this size. And you would never paste it into one anyway.

beats.footage: B-roll: hold on the loaded dataset and the sealed badges.
beats.text: So watch one analyse it anyway, without ever seeing a single row.

beats.footage: B-roll: cursor across the three sealed badges.
beats.text: Every column is graded before the agent is told the file exists. Name, email, employee I-D — sealed. It cannot group by them, filter on them, or ever receive them.

beats.footage: B-roll: department is reclassified to sealed, the toolset rebuilds, the same query is then refused.
beats.text: The grading is a heuristic — column names and how unique the values are — so sometimes it will be wrong. One click overrules it. Watch what happens when I seal a column the agent was just using: every tool is withdrawn and re-registered, the descriptions rewritten around the new grading, and the query that worked a moment ago is refused.

beats.footage: B-roll: the registered tool list opens.
beats.text: Eight WebMCP tools, and notice what is missing: there is no run-S-Q-L. The agent cannot write a query at all. It fills in a form, and the page compiles it. The same eight tools appear in ChatGPT and in Chrome behind the flag. This is the standard, not one app.

beats.footage: B-roll: the tools run, both charts appear.
beats.text: Schema. Cohort comparison. Chart. Each one across all one million rows in under a tenth of a second. And look at what just happened with that chart: the agent asked for it, I can see it, and the agent got back one word — drawn. Three percent pay gap at the junior levels, thirteen at the senior ones.

beats.footage: YOU: ChatGPT relaying the refusal, if you shot it — otherwise b-roll of two refusals in red.
beats.text: Ask who is paid most, and it refuses. A maximum is one real person's salary. And the refusal tells the agent what to ask instead, so it recovers on the next turn.

beats.footage: B-roll: the leak test refuses all five channels.
beats.text: But a counter reading zero is just this page marking its own homework. So the page revokes its own network access. Watch me try to leak the data on purpose. Fetch. X-H-R. WebSocket. Beacon. Tracking pixel. Chrome refuses all five.

beats.footage: B-roll: a feed row expands to its verbatim payload.
beats.text: And this is every byte the agent actually received. Not a summary — the literal text. Search it for a name, and there is none.

callout: (read from the ledger at record time)
beats.text: Ninety-nine megabytes in. Kilobytes out. Zero rows. And it holds: ten million rows, a full gigabyte, every query still under a second. Blindfold — analyse a file your A-I could never read.

optional.footage: YOU: the ChatGPT conversation, if you shoot it. Swap it in for 05-work.
optional.text: So I ask ChatGPT where pay is least equitable. It reads the schema, compares the cohorts level by level, and draws me the chart. It asked for that chart, I can see it, and what it got back was one word — drawn. It has still never seen a salary.
